snippet.title: Panda: Shards of Aurora Trailer
snippet.description:
🎥 Watch the official announcement trailer for Panda: Shards of Aurora!

Panda is back on an all-new adventure! Explore brand-new handcrafted icy peaks and a mysterious magical realm, guided by an ancient bear as you jump, dodge, and platform your way through 30 challenging levels. Stomp on penguins and seals, and uncover hidden secrets scattered across every frozen corner.

A charming pixel art platformer adventure that's perfect for casual players, completionists, achievement hunters, and platforming fans alike!

🚀 Panda: Shards of Aurora launches on September 17!

👍 Don't forget to like, comment, and subscribe to follow Panda's journey and stay tuned for future updates!

💬 Join our Discord and be part of the community: https://discord.gg/CGthHXKh3f

🙏 Support the project
Follow us on social media: 👉 https://linktr.ee/emberboxstudio
